source: FINDINGS-startup.md section 7 (loader 0x460BF0 reads the file); the class hierarchy (CStrategicResource : CModifier, introducing nothing) and FINDINGS-definitions.md (CModifier::LoadKey, inherited by 6 classes, `icon`); the modifier names from the base game's files and docs/script/modifiers.md.
